title: Analyst - ARC (Viz CoE)
description:
**About us:**  

Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change\-makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services, and Shared Services.
  
  

**Who you will work with:**  

This role is based out of the Visualizations CoE \- ARC team, which sits under the broader "Data \& Tech" cluster at the BCN. ARC is Bain's state\-of\-the\-art transformation management tool. We work closely with global Bain case teams, product teams and end\-clients providing them data analytics and business intelligence support using advanced data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, SQL, PowerApps, Python, GenAI, Azure, AWS, etc.). The Client Enablement team here is responsible for deploying highly functional business intelligence and automation solutions on the ARC Platform \- Bain's state\-of\-the\-art transformation management tool \- to help clients track progress of their transformation program.
  
  

**What you'll do:**  

\*
  
Work with Bain teams as an expert on specific tools, such as Microsoft power platforms (PowerBI, PowerAutomate), SQL and Python to design and deliver impactful business intelligence tools or dashboards
  
* Develop understanding about the ARC tool and the data fields contained within
* Work closely with the case team/ end\-client/ ARC Solution Delivery team to understand requirements, build proof of concepts and draw roadmap for output delivery with clear milestones
* Work under the guidance of a Senior Associate/ Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer and final materials, client communication, work planning, and team management
* Gather requirements and business process knowledge in order to transform the data in a way that is geared towards the needs of end\-users. Responsible for end\-to\-end handling of the entire process, i.e., requirement gathering, data cleaning, processing, visualization and deployment
* Apply knowledge of data warehousing and visualization to prepare dataflows using SQL, and then developing dashboards using PowerBI, to support case teams with analysis of KPIs and development of commercial dashboards
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of Power BI dashboards that deliver intuitive, high\-performance data visualizations with minimum iterations. You'll create complex data models and write optimized DAX formulas to support self\-service reporting and in\-depth analysis
* Automate workflows with Power Automate, allowing seamless integration between different applications, data sources, and business processes
* Solve complex custom visualization and analysis issues, providing thought leadership and business judgment
* Brainstorm any possible roadblocks with the team, providing thought leadership and business judgment
* Participate in case team calls and effectively communicate data, knowledge, insights and actionable next steps to the case team; relay implications to his/her own internal team
* Maintain documentation, metadata, and dictionaries for future reference


**About you:**  

\*
  
  

Candidate should be a Graduate from a Top\-tier College with strong academic records, and with 6 months to 1 year of relevant work experience in areas related to Data Management, Business Intelligence or Business Analytics.
  
* Experience in developing Power BI reports and dashboards, with a focus on data modeling, report performance optimization, and creating interactive visualizations (using tools such as Microsoft Power BI, SQL, and Python)
* Experience in developing custom Power Apps applications is a plus, with an emphasis on integrating Power Apps with diverse data sources, including SQL Server, Dataverse, and external APIs
* Competent with PowerBI Desktop, Gateway, Service and Report Server tools; good understanding of Power Query M\-code and hands\-on experience in building sophisticated DAX queries


What makes us a great place to work
  
  

We are proud to be \[1] consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for \[2] diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.
  
References
  
  

Visible links
  
1\. http://www.bain.com/about/what\-we\-do/awards/index.aspx
  
2\. https://www.bain.com/about/diversity\-inclusion/

title: SC Digitalization Analyst
description:
**SC Digitalization Analyst**
=============================

GURGAON, IN, 122001
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

  



Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

  



While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

**Position Overview:**



The Supply Chain Digitalization Analyst supports the execution of the Supply Chain Digitalization strategy by maintaining high\-quality Supply Chain data and delivering advanced analytics, insights, and Power BI solutions. Working under the direction of the SC Digitalization Manager, the role helps ensure data is structured, consistent, governed, and usable across systems to support operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, and cost optimization. The Analyst also supports the lifecycle management of dashboards and analytical tools aligned with global Supply Chain priorities.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Supply Chain Data Maintenance, Quality \& Governance:** Maintain, cleanse, harmonize, and improve Supply Chain data across operational, planning, inventory, service, cost, working capital, and performance domains. Resolve data inconsistencies through root cause analysis and sustainable fixes, while supporting Data Governance standards, definitions, documentation, and issue escalation.
* **Analytics Solution Development, Data Modeling \& Digital Tools:** Translate Supply Chain requirements into data models, semantic models, Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions aligned with data strategy and architecture. Partner with stakeholders to support Power BI builds and scalable analytics solutions using tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform / PowerApps, where applicable.
* **Reporting Lifecycle, Automation \& Standardization**: Maintain and improve global and regional Supply Chain scorecards, dashboards, and recurring reports. Manage refresh validation, issue resolution, enhancements, documentation, user support, KPI alignment, and report consolidation, while driving automation and standardization to improve scalability and consistency.
* **Advanced Analytics, Data\-Driven Insights \& Supply Chain Optimization:** Develop advanced analytics and network optimization models using complex Supply Chain data to improve operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, cost, and risk management. Partner with internal Supply Chain and cross\-functional teams gather data, maintain accurate baseline network models, evaluate customer shipping points, and assess strategic network opportunities, including greenfield locations and point\-of\-manufacturing options. Identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities, then translate insights into actionable recommendations that optimize transportation mileage, facility utilization, total Supply Chain cost, and ways of working.

  


**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent, in Supply Chain or related field.
* Minimum of 1\+ years in a Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Customer Service, Data Analytics, or related fields required.
* Experience working with complex, multi\-source datasets (SAP, BI tools, external data)
* Strong capability in data cleansing, structuring, and harmonization
* Demonstrated ability to perform advanced data analysis and generate actionable insights
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Apps; exposure to data platforms (e.g., Azure, SQL) preferred
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional group required. Strong written and oral communication skills are required.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to analyze complex problems to identify and correct root causes with minimum supervision.
* Ability to self\-manage and operate independently in environments that may not be black and white
* Operates as a continuous learner, proactively asking questions, challenges status quo and makes recommendations for improvement. Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills to communicate effectively at all levels.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Working with or in the Supply Chain function
* Previous use of Supply Chain Guru / Llamasoft, or comparable Network Modeling software
* Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, and existing network optimization analyses.


...



At McCormick, we have over a 100\-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value


**WHY WORK AT MCCORMICK?**
--------------------------


As a McCormick employee you’ll be empowered to focus on more than your individual responsibilities. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself—to have a say in where the company is going and how it’s growing.


Between our passion for flavor, our 130\-year history of leadership and integrity, the competitive and comprehensive benefits we offer, and our culture, which is built on respect and opportunities for growth, there are many reasons to join us at McCormick.

title: Product Manager, Google Partner Innovation
description:
For Singapore Applicants:


Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 1 year of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience developing and launching products or technologies within Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning (AI/ML).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience developing and launching successful products in AI/ML or related areas.
* Experience architecting agentic AI products utilizing tool\-calling, memory management, and evaluation pipelines.
* Profound experience in 'Vibe coding' via mainstream agentic tools, with willingness to dive into source code.
* Building products from the ground up in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Navigating complex infrastructure within large\-scale technical ecosystems and linking Google's latest AI models to applications driving growth.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Conceptualize, prototype, and define groundbreaking AI product opportunities within dynamic and ambiguous consumer environments, showcasing the forefront of Google's AI capabilities.
* Collaborate closely with DeepMind, Core ML, and other engineering teams to transform research breakthroughs into impactful product features, ensuring smooth integration and market alignment with Google's strategic partners.
* Support the entire product development process, from ideation and prototyping to launch and ongoing iteration, guaranteeing the timely delivery of exceptional AI features that resonate with users.
* Partner with Product Alliance Managers across various initiatives to cultivate captivating narratives and go\-to\-market strategies that highlight the distinctive value proposition of Google's AI solutions.

title: Product Manager – Executive Education
description:
**About the Role**

*We are looking for a Product Manager – Executive Education to conceptualise, design and evolve a differentiated portfolio of executive learning programmes across AI, Digital Transformation, Leadership, Strategy and emerging business themes.*

*This is a product strategy \+ programme design role. The ideal candidate will combine market intelligence, enterprise understanding and academic thinking to identify what organisations need, translate those needs into compelling executive education products, and take them from concept to market.*

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research and benchmark executive education programmes across leading B\-schools, universities, consulting firms and learning providers in India and globally.
* Track corporate learning trends, emerging technologies, business challenges, programme demand and pricing to identify new product opportunities.
* Conceptualise programmes based on identified market whitespace and enterprise capability gaps.
* Define target audience, programme objectives, learning outcomes, curriculum architecture, sequencing, duration and delivery format.
* Develop appropriate pedagogy including cases, simulations, projects, experiential learning, action learning and application\-based assignments.
* Create differentiated programme positioning, value propositions, USPs and pricing recommendations based on competitive analysis.
* Particularly for AI programmes, translate rapidly evolving technology into business application, leadership, transformation and organisational capability rather than tool\-based training alone.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–8 years of experience in product/programme management, executive education, L\&D, management consulting, corporate strategy, higher education or a related field.
* Strong understanding of management education and corporate learning.
* Excellent research, benchmarking, analytical and conceptualisation skills.
* Ability to understand enterprise challenges across strategy, people, processes, culture and technology.
* Strong understanding of learning outcomes, curriculum design and executive pedagogy.
* Commercial orientation with an understanding of market positioning, competitive differentiation and pricing.
* Excellent communication, writing and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong interest in AI, emerging technologies and the future of work.

**The Ideal Candidate**

*You are able to connect the dots between what enterprises need, what executives will value, what academia can credibly deliver and what the market will pay for.*

*If you are excited by building executive education products at the intersection of business, technology, AI and human capability, we would like to hear from you.*

Apply to join us in building the next generation of Executive Education products.

Pay: ₹70,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Healthcare Provider

description:

We work closely with higher education institutions, enterprises, SMEs, and governments to accelerate workforce and digital transformation in the AI era.

description:
E\-Commerce Key Account Manager – Walmart Sellers

Please read the Job Description carefully before applying.

This role is specifically for professionals with hands\-on experience in E\-commerce / Marketplace Key Account Management.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, results\-driven E\-Commerce Key Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of Walmart Marketplace sellers in the US market.

In this role, you will act as a strategic business partner for assigned Walmart sellers, helping them improve marketplace performance, increase sales, optimize their catalog and listings, resolve operational challenges, and identify opportunities for sustainable growth.

The ideal candidate should have direct experience working with e\-commerce marketplaces/platforms and managing seller or merchant accounts, preferably in a Key Account Manager, Marketplace Account Manager, Seller Success, Marketplace Operations, or similar capacity.

This is not a generic account\-management role. We are specifically looking for professionals who understand how e\-commerce marketplaces work and have experience managing seller/business accounts on platforms such as Walmart Marketplace, Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Ameesha ,Shopify, or similar platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Walmart Seller Account Management

* Own and manage a portfolio of Walmart Marketplace seller accounts in the US.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and strategic business partner for assigned sellers.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with sellers and understand their business objectives.
* Conduct regular account/business reviews and track seller performance against agreed KPIs.
* Identify account\-level risks, opportunities, and growth areas and proactively recommend actions.

Marketplace Growth \& Performance

* Develop and execute strategies to improve seller GMV, sales, conversion, traffic, catalog performance, and overall marketplace growth.
* Analyze seller performance data and identify opportunities for revenue and profitability improvement.
* Recommend appropriate promotional, pricing, advertising, and merchandising strategies.
* Identify high\-potential categories, products, and expansion opportunities.
* Drive seller adoption of relevant Walmart Marketplace programs and initiatives.

Catalog \& Listing Optimization

* Guide sellers on product listing quality, content, attributes, categorization, pricing, and discoverability.
* Work with sellers to improve product titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and overall catalog quality.
* Identify listing/content gaps affecting visibility and conversion.
* Monitor product and category performance and recommend corrective actions.

Marketplace Operations

* Support sellers in resolving marketplace\-related operational issues.
* Work with internal teams to address issues related to catalog, inventory, pricing, orders, fulfillment, returns, and seller performance.
* Help sellers understand and improve compliance with marketplace policies and performance standards.
* Proactively identify recurring operational problems and develop solutions.

Strategic Account Management

* Prepare and present regular business reviews, performance insights, action plans, and growth recommendations.
* Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity pipelines, and performance trackers.
* Forecast account growth and identify opportunities to expand seller engagement.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Operations, Catalog, Marketing, Advertising, and Seller Support.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Required Experience

Mandatory:

* 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in E\-commerce / Marketplace Key Account Management.
* Experience managing seller/merchant accounts on an e\-commerce marketplace or platform.
* Experience with Walmart Marketplace is highly preferred.
* Candidates with experience managing sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Shopify, or other major marketplaces may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of marketplace metrics such as GMV, revenue, conversion rate, traffic, Buy Box/competitive pricing, catalog quality, inventory, fulfillment, and seller performance.
* Demonstrated experience in growing marketplace accounts and achieving business targets.
* Experience conducting account reviews/business reviews with sellers or merchants.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketplace performance data.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are specifically looking for candidates currently working or previously working as:

* E\-Commerce Key Account Manager
* Marketplace Key Account Manager
* Walmart Account Manager
* Amazon Account Manager
* Marketplace Account Manager
* Seller Success Manager – E\-commerce
* Marketplace Growth Manager
* E\-commerce Business Manager
* Marketplace Operations Manager
* Merchant Success / Seller Success Manager

Candidates from Walmart, Amazon, Meesho, Flipkart, eBay, Shopify, marketplace aggregators, e\-commerce brands, seller agencies, or e\-commerce service providers with relevant seller/account management experience are encouraged to apply.

Who Should NOT Apply

This position is specifically focused on E\-commerce Marketplace Key Account Management.

Please do not apply if your experience is primarily in:

* Banking or financial services
* Insurance
* Loan/credit card sales
* Relationship Manager – Banking
* Branch banking
* General customer service
* BPO/customer support
* Generic client servicing
* Traditional sales/account handling without marketplace experience
* Non\-e\-commerce business development

Only candidates with relevant E\-commerce / Marketplace seller or merchant account management experience will be shortlisted.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of E\-commerce marketplaces
* Seller/Merchant account management
* Walmart Marketplace knowledge preferred
* Marketplace performance analysis
* Business development and revenue growth
* Catalog and listing optimization
* Promotional and pricing strategy
* Strong Excel/data analysis skills
* KPI and performance management
* Stakeholder and relationship management
* Excellent verbal and written English communication
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making ability
* Ability to manage multiple high\-value seller accounts
* Strategic and commercially driven mindset

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, E\-commerce, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of relevant E\-commerce / Marketplace Account Management experience.
* Proven track record of managing and growing seller/merchant accounts.
* Walmart Marketplace experience will be a strong advantage.

Why Join Us?

* Work closely with US\-based Walmart Marketplace sellers.
* Gain exposure to international e\-commerce marketplace operations.
* Manage high\-impact seller accounts and directly influence business growth.
* Work in a fast\-growing e\-commerce environment.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in marketplace strategy, seller growth, and account management.
* Learn from experienced e\-commerce professionals.
* Build a career in the rapidly growing global e\-commerce ecosystem.
